requirement: OPS-10「接手者可以從乾淨環境重跑全部已宣稱能力。驗收：命令、設定、來源、硬體與證據齊全；缺少項目明示受阻。」
scope: scripts/clean-env-verify.sh exports the committed tree with git archive into a scratch workdir, links the official MaleCNS directory into it, and runs every claimed capability in order: module download and verification, build, vet, the full test suite, doctor, the fixture experiments, every fixture example, the fixture benchmark, the multitask suite, the small recompute RSS check, the real-subgraph import and training, the full-graph validation, short training, resume and store-mode benchmark, the two always-blocked items, and the completion report. Every step writes its command, a configuration hash, its status and its log to run.json.
reproduction_command: GOMEMLIMIT=8GiB /usr/bin/time -l bash scripts/clean-env-verify.sh --workdir runs/OPS-10/work --data data/malecns-v1.0 --out evidence/OPS-10/run.json > evidence/OPS-10/run.stdout 2> evidence/OPS-10/run.time.log
cp runs/OPS-10/work/report.json evidence/OPS-10/completion-report.json; cp runs/OPS-10/work/report.md evidence/OPS-10/completion-report.md

assumption_statement: A clean export rules out stray files in the working tree; it is not a fresh machine. The Go toolchain, its module cache, the official data files and ffmpeg come from this Mac.
limitations: One macOS arm64 machine; Linux and Windows reruns are OPS-04's platform matrix, not repeated here.

GOMEMLIMIT=8GiB was set for every step so the full-graph steps fit a 16 GiB machine.
